title: An answer closes its question, and a directory record the reducer cannot read is refused in its own words
note: AUD-060 and AUD-061. The agent directory refuses an escalation answer that leaves the question open (AD1), as the second reader does, and refuses each malformed record in its own words with its position (AD2 to AD9). tests/test_agent_directory_records.py holds each.

mutations.name: AD1_an_answer_may_leave_the_question_open
mutations.rationale: an answer left OPEN records a person's answer on a question still open, and the next answer replaces it

mutations.name: AD2_a_registration_with_no_identity_is_refused_in_other_words
mutations.find:
rec = p.get("identity")
            if not isinstance(rec, dict):
mutations.rationale: a registration carrying no identity is refused without its position

mutations.name: AD3_a_retirement_naming_no_instance_raises
mutations.find:
iid = p.get("instance_id")
            if not isinstance(iid, str) or not iid:
mutations.rationale: a retirement naming its instance by a list raises TypeError out of the reducer

mutations.name: AD4_a_message_record_with_no_message_is_refused_in_other_words
mutations.find:
rec = p.get("message")
            if not isinstance(rec, dict):
mutations.rationale: a message record carrying no message is refused without its position

mutations.name: AD5_a_claim_lacking_its_fields_raises
mutations.rationale: a claim record lacking its id, task, subject or value raises KeyError out of the reducer

mutations.name: AD6_a_claim_in_no_known_role_raises
mutations.rationale: a claim naming a role this version does not know raises ValueError out of the reducer

mutations.name: AD7_an_escalation_record_with_no_escalation_is_refused_in_other_words
mutations.find:
rec = p.get("escalation")
            if not isinstance(rec, dict):
mutations.rationale: an escalation record carrying no escalation is refused without its position

mutations.name: AD8_an_answer_naming_no_escalation_is_refused_in_other_words
mutations.find:
eid = p.get("escalation_id")
            if not isinstance(eid, str) or not eid:
mutations.rationale: an answer naming no escalation is refused as one for an escalation never opened

mutations.name: AD9_an_answer_to_no_known_state_raises
mutations.rationale: an answer moving the question to a state that does not exist raises ValueError out of the reducer
